fix_subject: Fix #6044: in Value::DECIMAL, switch on the width instead of assuming the width is correctly set with the corresponding integer type
pr_title: Fix #6044: in Value::DECIMAL, switch on the width instead of assuming the width is correctly set with the corresponding integer type

labels.summary: Value::DECIMAL for int16 and int32 inputs trusted the caller-supplied width, so a mismatched width (e.g. from Parquet decimal metadata) stored a value in the wrong integer slot, producing wrong results or tripping an assertion; the fix dispatches all three overloads through the int64 path, which selects storage by width.
